## How Has This Been Tested?

Please describe the tests you ran to verify your changes:

- [ ] Tested bot locally using `bun run dev`
- [ ] Checked for type errors using `bun run typecheck` and built with `bun run build`

## Checklist

- [ ] My code is written in ForgeScript first and adds no JavaScript that a native `$function` can replace.
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code.
- [ ] I have not applied automatic linter/formatter on ForgeScript files (to avoid syntax corruption).
- [ ] My changes generate no new errors or warnings during type check (`bun run typecheck`).
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules.
